title: IPX Verification Cross-Reference Matrix (VCRM)
description: Single source of truth for IPX mandatory SHALL requirements, linking Verification (built right) and Validation (built the right thing) to live Terminal & Eval evidence.

requirements.title: Zero Future Leakage
requirements.requirement: All t_0 signal snapshots SHALL be frozen strictly before outcome resolution (0 timestamp leakage violations).

requirements.title: 48–72h Recheck Discipline
requirements.requirement: Pending 48–72h prediction calls SHALL be resolved on schedule with 0 overdue calls.

requirements.title: Brier Calibration Floor
requirements.requirement: Resolved Quant calls SHALL maintain a Brier calibration score >= 70.0% across at least 3 resolved outcomes.

requirements.title: Active Multi-Factor Coverage
requirements.requirement: The Quant Screener SHALL track >= 5 IP entities with at least 1 STRONG_SIGNAL candidate surfaced.

requirements.title: Prediction Market Grounding
requirements.requirement: At least 1 live Polymarket or Kalshi contract SHALL be frozen as a t_0 signal for Odds-vs-Social divergence tracking.

requirements.title: Independent Eval Gate
requirements.requirement: The latest completed IPX-Eval run SHALL achieve an overall score >= 75.0% on independent held-out outcomes.

requirements.title: Real-World Creative Outcomes
requirements.requirement: The Creative Studio / Auto-Pairer SHALL log >= 2 graded real-world 48h outcomes (winner/flop) to avoid circular AI grading.

requirements.title: Human-vs-AI Edge Tracking
requirements.requirement: Resolved calls SHALL include >= 1 AI benchmark prediction so Human Quant vs. AI edge is continuously measurable.
